title: Pocket calculator
description:
Read a calculation such as `8 * 5`: a decimal number, an operator character, and another decimal number. Print the answer.

- Supported operators: `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`.
- Dividing by zero prints `Cannot divide by zero`.
- Any other operator prints `Unknown operator`.

Use a `switch` on the operator character.

| Input | Output |
|---|---|
| `8 * 5` | `40` |
| `7 / 2` | `3.5` |
| `1 / 0` | `Cannot divide by zero` |
| `2 ^ 3` | `Unknown operator` |
hints: Every `case` needs a `break;` at the end, or the program carries on into the next case.
